5475.title: Mention candidate freshness and coverage
5475.rootCauseOneLine: A pre-match sidebar cap drops later threads; an Infinity-stale cache cannot recover missed updates on reopening; path rows retain previous-query data through debounce and placeholder requests.
5475.proposedFix: Refresh the mention observer baseline on reopening, match against the full bootstrap candidate set, and suppress path rows during debounce and per-source placeholder requests.
5475.caveats: Direct hook integration on Linux; missed realtime delivery is simulated, not diagnosed on the reporter machine. Same agent repeated both clean runs. Startup-only fallback remains capped until complete bootstrap replaces it.
